modifications: Subset to U+20C1 plus required .notdef glyph; no artwork redrawn.
Rename family/full/PostScript identifiers to NasaqRiyal; retain upstream copyright and license metadata.
Remove unrelated layout tables; compress as WOFF2.

reproduction.prerequisites: Install fonttools==4.59.2 and Brotli==1.1.0; extract the archiveMember from the verified upstream ZIP. Save the Python script below as subset-riyal.py.
reproduction.pythonScript:
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools import subset
import sys
font=TTFont(sys.argv[1],recalcTimestamp=False)
options=subset.Options()
options.flavor="woff2"
options.glyph_names=True
options.notdef_outline=True
options.name_IDs=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,13,14,16,17]
options.name_legacy=True
options.name_languages=["*"]
options.layout_features=[]
options.drop_tables += ["GDEF","GPOS","GSUB"]
subsetter=subset.Subsetter(options=options)
subsetter.populate(unicodes=[0x20C1])
subsetter.subset(font)
renames={1:"NasaqRiyal",2:"Regular",3:"NasaqRiyal Regular 2.021 subset 2026-11-01",4:"NasaqRiyal Regular",6:"NasaqRiyal-Regular",16:"NasaqRiyal",17:"Regular"}
for record in font["name"].names:
    if record.nameID in renames:
        record.string=renames[record.nameID].encode(record.getEncoding())
font.flavor="woff2"
font.save(sys.argv[2])
